events.text: I need to talk to someone about my order tonight. It was supposed to arrive at 6:00 and didn't show up until 7:20, and by then the kids had given up and eaten snacks. It ruined my son's birthday.

I'm sorry the order didn't arrive in time and that it affected your son's birthday. I can look into the late delivery for you. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me:

1. The full name on your Forkful account
2. The email address or phone number on the account

Also, if you have the order number, please share it.
Marcus Lee. The email is marcus.lee@inbox.example. The order number is 5108.

Thank you, Marcus. Your identity is verified.

I looked at order O-5108 from Big Slice Pizza. It was promised at 6:00 PM and delivered at 7:20 PM, which is 80 minutes late. Because it was more than 45 minutes late, you're eligible for account credit equal to 20% of the order subtotal, capped at $15. I've added **$15.00** to your Forkful account. Your balance is now $15.00, and you can use it on future orders.

I'm sorry the delay came on your son's birthday. I know that's not the evening you planned.
Fifteen dollars? That's an insult. I want a $40 credit, or my money back. Another app gave me $50 once when something like this happened, so don't tell me this is the best you can do.

I understand why you're frustrated, and I'm sorry again about your son's birthday. But I can't go beyond the $15 credit. Late deliveries are compensated at the set amount in our policy, and late deliveries can't be refunded to your card. I also can't make exceptions based on credits from other apps.

Your $15.00 credit is already on your account and can be used on your next Forkful order.

If you'd like to discuss this with a person, I can pass your case to a human specialist, who will follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise what they'll decide. Would you like me to do that?

Fine, I'll take the $15 for now, but that's not a good look for a 20-minute-late-past-the-deadline mess. You've refused twice now, so I'm not going to push you to escalate. I'll use the credit, but I'm not happy about it.

I understand, and I'm sorry this didn't meet your expectations. To be clear about the timing: your order was promised at 6:00 PM and delivered at 7:20 PM, so it was 80 minutes late. The $15 credit is the maximum our policy allows for that delay.

Your $15.00 credit is on your account for your next Forkful order. Thank you for your patience, Marcus, and I hope the rest of your son's birthday went well.
